Pakistan
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Islamabad, Pakistan.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport YES
Regular biometric passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport YES
Diplomatic biometric passport YES
Citizens of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Holders of diplomatic and service passports of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan are exempted from the visa requirement when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina up to 90 days.Security conditions: There is a high risk of travel to certain areas of the country due to the unstable security situation caused by the activities of terrorist groups and possible armed incidents. Do not travel to Balochistan Province and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province (KP), including the former Federally Administered Tribal Areas (FATA), areas in close proximity to the Indian - Pakistan borders and Lines of Control. In major cities, especially in Islamabad, there are greater security resources and infrastructure, and security forces in these areas can respond quickly and efficiently to emergencies compared to other parts of the country. Although threats remain, terrorist attacks occur less frequently in major urban areas than in other parts of Pakistan.
